index.title: Organizations
index.text: Your groups, companies, branches and departments. Settings and rules flow down this tree.
index.empty_text: Units you can access will appear here.

show.no_children: No units under this one yet.
show.not_found_text: It does not exist, or it is outside the organizations you can see.

settings.title: Regional settings
settings.text: Empty values are inherited from the level above.

form.create_text: Create a company, branch or department under an existing unit.
form.no_child_types: Nothing can be added under this unit. Choose another parent.
form.name: Name
form.sector_hint: A new company starts with the modules, roles and settings of its sector. Everything can be changed later.
form.inherit_hint: Leave empty to use the value from the level above.
form.country_hint: Brings its language, timezone, currency, week and weekend unless set here.
form.currency_invalid: Use the 3-letter currency code, e.g. BDT.
form.status_hint: Suspended or archived units and everything under them cannot be used.
form.sector_hint_edit: Changing the sector keeps the current setup. Apply the new sector's package from the overview if you want it.
form.sector_required: Choose the sector of the company.
form.created_with_package: {name} was created with the {package} package: {modules} modules, {roles} roles and {rules} settings.

move.title: Move {name}
move.text: Everything under this unit moves with it.
move.reason_placeholder: e.g. Branch reorganized under the Chattogram company
move.note: Inherited settings and rules will now come from the new parent. The move is recorded in the audit log.

members.add_text: Give an existing account access to {name}.
members.email_hint: The person must already have an account.
members.scope_hint: Group members can see only the group, or every company in it.
members.suspend_text: They will not be able to open this organization until someone reactivates them.
members.empty_text: Add people so they can work in this organization.
